CustomField.description: Synthetic integration test account. While true, this account and its Orders, Order Products and Opportunities are excluded from Business Central publication, onboarding/financial emails, bell notifications and BAU generation. Only users with the Integration_Test_Isolation_Admin_CC custom permission can set or clear it (validation rule Integration_Test_Record_Protected). Keep it set while any test fixture remains.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Synthetic integration test data. Integrations and notifications are suppressed for this account and its orders.
CustomField.label: Integration Test Record
